# Salesforce API limits and sync failures

> Why a sync to Salesforce fails with API limits and how to fix it. "API limit" covers several problems: the daily API allocation (org-wide, rolling 24 hours, shared by every integration), concurrent long-running requests, record locking (UNABLE_TO_LOCK_ROW), automation governor limits (triggers, flows, Apex) and errors that are not limits at all. A per-second rate limit stops bursts but does not cap the daily total. Covers sync pace (rate limit per app, Data Sync Frequency, bulk, full table scans), queues and batching, a triage runbook, and tested tools to classify errors, estimate API spend and simulate pacing. Uses Stacksync.

Stacksync Salesforce connector: https://www.stacksync.com/connectors/salesforce
Stacksync two-way sync: https://www.stacksync.com/two-way-sync
Stacksync workflow automation: https://www.stacksync.com/workflow-automation
Stacksync event queues: https://www.stacksync.com/event-queues
Stacksync MCP: https://www.stacksync.com/mcp
